Production PIXEL ART for the existing Sproto fighting game. Crisp stepped pixels, dark outlines, compact limited-color shading. Not smooth vector or painterly art. Each cell contains exactly ONE complete actor facing RIGHT, consistent three-quarter side view. Preserve the reference identity, facial shape, exact eye count, colors, clothing, accessories and individually described body shape. Same head, torso and limb proportions in every frame. Exactly two arms and two legs per actor, legs rooted at the LOWEST pelvis below the belly. Low hip, chambered knee and connected ankle for every kick. Never attach legs to the chest. Keep all limbs and feet wholly inside their own cell with generous empty margins; no clipping. Flat solid pure MAGENTA #ff00ff background, no grid lines, labels, shadows, trails, floating particles or weapons. Worn/held identity accessories must remain attached to body or hand. Extend cropped lower bodies conservatively using matching skin/clothing colors and simple shoes. Complete separate body drawings; no limb cutouts. Both feet need readable soles. No extra subjects.

Exactly 32 separate complete drawings, regular 4-column by 8-row grid, read left-to-right/top-to-bottom. All 32 are the SAME single actor, including lying floor drawings. No opponents or partner drawn.
Row 1 INTRO: jaunty red-crest head tilt; graceful hand flourish near waist; lively planted pivot; confident combat guard. Exactly four full-body key drawings.
Row 2 SPECIAL A: low coil; shoulder windup; fully extended straight impact punch; punch retract.
Row 3 SPECIAL B: alternate shoulder strike; retract to cover; two-arm finishing palm thrust to RIGHT; recover combat guard. No floating effects.
Row 4 CAST: head leans back to inhale, hands remain raised; cheeks visibly inflate with pursed red lips and chin slightly raised; head snaps forward, mouth opens to SPIT horizontally RIGHT, hands remain in guard near chest; cheeks relax and mouth returns to the normal smile. NO palm cast or extended hand, NO projectile or miniature Sproto drawn: the engine supplies the mini at the mouth.
Row 5 RECOIL: chest impact arch; head/torso lean back with arms still connected; bend knees to absorb; regain combat guard.
Row 6 DEFEAT START: staggering upright; knees buckle; dropping toward floor with bent elbows; roll onto side with head and feet fully visible.
Row 7 DEFEAT FLOOR: entirely lying on side, head to LEFT feet to RIGHT; same lying body settles; small final shoulder drop; side-lying completely still. No kneeling or standing in any of these four.
Row 8 DEFEAT REST: same side-lying floor silhouette with tiny relaxed hand change; same side-lying rest; same resting body; final completely relaxed side-lying body. Floor poses are lower than standing poses; never stretch them upright. All hats, heads, hands and feet remain connected and fully visible. Ranged attack is a MOUTH SPIT: cheeks puff, lips purse, head snaps RIGHT with an open mouth, hands stay near ribs. No extended palm cast. Collapse retains the original red or blue identity, outfit, head and horn; final eight drawings fully lie on their side with head LEFT and feet RIGHT. No vanishing or replacement silhouettes.

Exactly 32 complete dynamic pixel-art figures in an EXACTLY FOUR-COLUMN by EIGHT-ROW regular grid. Each of the following rows contains EXACTLY FOUR figures; do not create a fifth column. Equal cell width/height; generous empty magenta margins around each body. Same single actor throughout.
Row 1 DASH: crouch-drive anticipation; rear-leg powerful push; low traveling stride with front knee drive; long low traveling stride with coherent bent knees.
Row 2 DASH TO JUMP: front foot brakes and torso rises; guard recovery; tucked rising jump with bent low knees; springing airborne rise with front arm high.
Row 3 JUMP: folded knees at apex; falling with arms balancing; feet reach down; falling landing-ready with both feet below hips. These are airborne silhouettes, no floor.
Row 4 HEAVY KICK: low hip coil; front knee chambers from low pelvis; knee rises; SIDE KICK fully extended waist-high to RIGHT.
Row 5 HEAVY RECOVERY: sustain extended side kick one beat; knee folds back; grounded follow-through; guard.
Row 6 AIR KICK: compact aerial coil; front knee chambers; knee opens; forceful extended diagonal kick to RIGHT, rear knee folded.
Row 7 AIR TO VICTORY: knee retracts in air; balanced airborne recovery; confident upright victory guard; victory knees coil.
Row 8 VICTORY: jubilant short hop with fist up; stylish landing crouch; proud standing hero stance; settled triumphant hero pose. No effects, no additional figures. Exactly 4 figures per row, 8 rows.
